commit_title: fix(evidence): correct price enums and longitudinal provenance

fix_b_price_enum_deserialization.root_cause: SQLAlchemy Enum(PriceEvidenceType) defaults to matching Enum member NAMES ('OBSERVED_CHECKOUT_PRICE'), while manual SQL migrations previously inserted lowercase values ('observed_checkout_price'). When queried via ORM, SQLAlchemy threw LookupError.
fix_b_price_enum_deserialization.solution: Standardized PriceEvidenceType on uppercase values, added _missing_ classmethod for backwards compatibility, explicit values_callable=lambda obj: [e.value for e in obj], and executed idempotent migration updating all existing rows to uppercase.
fix_b_price_enum_deserialization.verified_by: backend/tests/test_price_enum_storage.py (ORM insert, raw SQL verify uppercase, ORM round-trip without LookupError)

fix_c_price_evidence_taxonomy.root_cause: Shopify storefront variant lists were previously misclassified as OBSERVED_CHECKOUT_PRICE. Storefront variants only prove catalog listing prices, not completed checkout/cart inspection.
fix_c_price_evidence_taxonomy.solution: Reclassified all 44 Shopify storefront variant offers to OBSERVED_RETAIL_LISTING_PRICE. Reserved OBSERVED_CHECKOUT_PRICE strictly for verified cart/checkout flows. Classified Amazon listings as OBSERVED_RETAIL_LISTING_PRICE and modeled bundles as SCENARIO_PRICE.

fix_d_t0_snapshot_reconciliation.root_cause: The repository contains 145 distinct Meta ads, but 290 snapshot rows across two collection dates.

provenance.batch_t1: 145 snapshots on 2026-11-10 18:09:05 UTC (daily re-observation across 14 runs)
provenance.longitudinal_interpretation: Represents 2 consecutive observation dates (T0 and T+1). Does NOT represent a 14-day longitudinal proof. 100% of historical data preserved without deletion or timestamp alteration.

fix_d_t0_snapshot_reconciliation.t14_freeze_status: T+14 monitoring remains strictly frozen until Nov 24, 2026 after 01:26 ICT

fix_e_balanced_scoring_endpoint_guard.root_cause: POST /api/v1/scores/compute previously accepted arbitrary mode parameters, creating risk of accidental score overwrite if non-balanced mode was supplied.
fix_e_balanced_scoring_endpoint_guard.solution: Enforced strict route validation: any mode != 'balanced' raises HTTP 400 Bad Request with explicit explanation that production rankings require v4_balanced_multimodel.
